text:
sam: Heads-up — Meridian Health just escalated to exec kickoff. CISO wants a signed pilot addendum, BYOK/KMS plan, evidence of region-only processing for EU, and a throughput SLA before they start integrating. They also asked for pen-test summary and confirmation we won't exfiltrate logs. Need owners asap.
izzy: I'll coordinate on the stakeholder invite. Who's the primary contact? Need CISO + infra lead + procurement.
sam: Contacts: Elena Varga (CISO), Tomas Varga (Head of Infra), Priyanka Rao (Procurement). I'll DM emails.
rachel: I'll take the BYOK/KMS integration. Quick summary: Dedicated supports customer KMS for key wrapping; Private supports HSM with limited automation. For a 90-day pilot we can do KMS wrap + manual rotation workflow. Will draft a short playbook by EOD.
amar: I'll own region isolation and pilot infra. We can spin up an isolated eu-north-1 pilot cluster with storage and logs pinned to EU. Need legal to confirm wording we can commit to in the addendum.
legal: Legal here — we can agree to region-processing for pilot duration, but must limit long-term residency guarantees. Pen-test reports require an NDA and we usually share redacted summaries. Please file a legal request with subject "Meridian pen-test".
izzy: Pricing ask: Meridian wants a simple fixed price for a 3-month pilot and an option for metered usage. Can someone make two quick numbers (flat reserved + metered with pilot discount)? I can fold into the deck for the kickoff.
sam: Also they want a throughput SLA: target is 200 req/s sustained, p99 <= 180ms for chat-gen routes. They want a brief failover runbook and a rollback plan. Rachel/Amar can we validate feasibility?
rachel: Performance check: 200 rps is doable on 3 reserved nodes with continuous batching, but tail can spike with streaming. I'll run a smoke benchmark tonight with a sample payload set. Need sample size and representative messages.
amar: I'll include autoscale runway in the cost model for spikes and a short failover play: cross-region read-only fallback to eu-west with degraded throughput. Will document required peering and failback steps.
legal: Also flagging data retention: Meridian wants logs purged at pilot end. We can confirm retention controls and put a deletion clause in the addendum.
izzy: I'll request the security questionnaire version and sample payloads from Meridian now. Ask them to label payloads as sanitized or real PII.
ops-bot: ticket created: MER-10007 "Meridian Health pilot: BYOK + EU-residency + SLA". Assigned: infra-pilot, se-oncall, legal-queue.
sam: Great. For the exec kickoff I propose two asks to present: 1) Meridian signs pilot addendum + NDA for pen-test exchange, 2) a 3-month pilot credit + access to sanitized payloads for perf tests.
rachel: One technical caveat: full delegated-admin for their IdP provisioning isn't supported without infra change; SCIM basic user/group sync is ok. If they insist we can offer an SE-managed proxy for the pilot. I'll include options.
amar: Network-security note: if they want packet-capture or network-level testing we must coordinate with eng-telemetry and a signed SOW. Also any on-prem connector requires host attestations.
legal: I'll start a draft pilot addendum with region-processing clause, retention clause, and NDA instructions. ETA: tomorrow morning.
izzy: Can we schedule the kickoff? Meridian asked for next Wednesday 11:00 CET. Internal folks please confirm.
sam: I can do it. Rachel?
rachel: I'll join. Amar?
amar: Yes. Legal will attend once draft addendum is ready.
izzy: Thanks — I'll send invites and a one-slide summary (asks + owners + timeline) in 60m. Please add any slides to this thread.
ops-bot: reminder: meeting created 2026-06-09T11:00:00+02:00 (Meridian Health Exec Kickoff).
sam: Closing loop for now — will post the questionnaire and sample payloads when Meridian replies. :white_check_mark:
